title: MPI I: processes and point-to-point messages
status: reviewed and locally validated; independent round 2 ACCEPT
transcript_provenance: Local machine transcription (faster-whisper small.en); not publisher captions
source_uncertainties: Full assigned local machine transcripts were read and the listed frames inspected. No independent complete audio review was performed; no public quotation is based on a garbled machine rendering.
MPI 4.1 is the normative reference. The installed MPI_Get_version reports MPI 3.1; all listed routines predate MPI 4.1. This is not a full wording-by-wording comparison between standard editions.

The Open MPI launcher URL currently serves 4.1.8 documentation. Local programs use the installed 4.1 series. The TCP explanatory URL is a5.0-series document; transport arguments were also exercised locally rather than presumed identical across releases.

The earlier Hockney paper was not independently opened in this author pass and is not a directly relied-upon source. Model form and historical attribution come from the opened Thakur/Rabenseifner/Gropp primary paper, § 3.

No new unmatched-message hang or eager-threshold experiment was run. The defect of the eight-rank lecture program is established from message counting and MPI 4.1 Example 11.4. Old paused-draft vader measurements and uncontrolled distributions were excluded.

Four timing captures used TCP loopback+self and no binding in an exclusive agent execution slot; OS background activity, processor frequency and migration were not controlled. Minimum/median refer to seven trial batch means, not individual message latency distributions.

Least-squares fits are descriptive. The large-message fit uses only three observations. No protocol threshold or causal explanation of timing bends is established. The 8000-byte halo prediction interpolates the small-range fit; no 8000-byte measurement was made.

Open MPI emitted debugger_attach_fifo errno 95 under the Windows-mounted workspace. Raw stderr is retained privately; program data checks and exits succeeded, while debugger attachment is unavailable and untested.

The code-lab functional verification reran pingpong once after the four timing captures. That output is not included in the reported four-capture ranges. Raw outputs and provenance are retained privately.

The paused chapter14 original remains preserved and is not treated as previously accepted. This version replaces its empirical sections and many listings rather than inheriting their all-passed claims.
lecture_corrections: Separate process launch from MPI_Init initialization inside each process. Same PID before/after initialization checked locally.
Recv count is a capacity; actual count is obtained from completed status using MPI_Get_count.
The eight-process single-receive branch leaves six of seven sends unmatched; one printed42 does not establish valid finalization.
Unlimited process launching requires resources and launcher configuration; Open MPI slots can forbid a request without oversubscription.
Unspecified output/source selection is not a uniform random distribution and first terminal output need not be first finished process.
Same executable on all ranks is the SPMD convention, not an MPI requirement.
